title: Australian Burger Wrap
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic burger, featuring an australian-inspired patty filled with crunchy slaw and icy cool sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Australian Burger Patties (made with icy water)

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill to medium-high heat.
Cook the Australian Burger Patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, assemble the crunchy slaw by mixing together store-bought or homemade slaw and any additional desired ingredients.
Toast the burger buns by grilling them for 1-2 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of icy cool sauce on the bottom bun.
Add a cooked patty, followed by a layer of crunchy slaw, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and finally the top bun.
Optional: Add additional toppings such as red onion, cheese, or avocado to make the burger even more delicious.
